jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Build responsive web interfaces, collaborate with designers, and ship clean UI features for our SaaS products. You will work closely with backend engineers and take ownership of reusable component patterns.

jobs.title: Java Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Design and maintain REST APIs, write reliable services, and improve the performance of our core platform. Experience with relational databases and code reviews is expected.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Create user flows, high-fidelity mockups, and design systems for web and mobile products. You will run lightweight usability reviews with product and engineering teams.

jobs.title: Cloud Support Associate
jobs.description: Help customers deploy and operate cloud workloads. You will diagnose incidents, write runbooks, and grow into a well-rounded cloud engineer.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Own CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and production reliability. You will partner with development teams to make releases safer and faster.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Turn product and finance data into clear dashboards and insights. You will work with stakeholders to define metrics and present weekly business reviews.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Build customer-facing features across the stack. You will write APIs, craft clean UI, and participate in sprint planning with product managers.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: Plan test cycles, automate high-value scenarios, and keep quality visible to the team. Strong communication and bug reporting skills are essential.
